result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane intersection designed primarily for high-speed vehicle throughput with minimal pedestrian infrastructure. The environment is characterized by long crossing distances, a lack of marked crosswalks, and the presence of a high-speed slip lane.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic across a wide intersection without a protected refuge.

hazards.name: High-Speed Slip Lane
hazards.description: A channelized right-turn lane allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, increasing risk to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Control
hazards.description: The intersection lacks visible pedestrian signals and marked crosswalks despite being signalized for vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised refuge island in the median to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signalization
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and accessible push buttons to manage crossing movements.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, characterized by a complete lack of sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or pedestrian signals at a wide, multi-lane intersection. The design prioritizes high-speed vehicle throughput, leaving pedestrians with long, unprotected crossing distances and no dedicated space.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or marked crosswalks, forcing any pedestrians to walk in the grass or roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and intersection area

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway creates a long, unprotected exposure time for anyone attempting to cross.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install paved sidewalks on both sides of the roadway to provide a safe, separated path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian signal heads to manage crossings at the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Modify the existing medians to include cut-throughs and waiting areas for pedestrians to reduce crossing exposure.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with faded crosswalk markings and basic pedestrian signals. While some infrastructure like curb ramps and sidewalks are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median refuge create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalks
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the frame.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven surfaces on the sidewalk and roadway near the curb ramp could pose a tripping hazard.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge island to break up the long crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
